assessment_summary.cou_name: Predict bending stiffness, peak stress, and hotspot ranking under ISO 7206-4/8 for sizes 1–5

evidence_keywords: Abaqus/Standard 2023 FD03 with SMP
Model and scripts tracked in Git (repo MS-hipstem-fea, tag v1.7.2)
Results are replicable on Windows 11 and RHEL 8
hash-matched output within 0.2% across platforms
verified against NAFEMS LE10 bending benchmark (error 0.4% in displacement)
custom cantilever with an analytical tip-load solution (error 0.3% in stress)
Three-level refinement around the fillet
1.8% Grid Convergence Index (95% confidence)
peak von Mises at the notch root
compliance changed <0.8% between last two meshes
Nonlinear solution with NLGEOM=ON
force residual tolerance 0.5%, displacement norm 0.1 mm
Energy balance error <1.5% at convergence
Contact overclosure at the potting interface averaged 2.4 μm
Independent check by S. Liang (not on the design team)
cataloged in Confluence page FEA-HIP-ISO-BEND v1.7
Not to be used for patient gait cycles, fretting, or corrosion-fatigue without additional evidence
Base material is wrought Ti-6Al-4V ELI
Elastoplastic response is represented with a bilinear hardening rule (yield 880 MPa, tangent 1.2 GPa)
stem–PMMA contact modeled as bonded
No parameter fitting to bench data was performed
elastic modulus 110±3 GPa and 0.34 Poisson from heat-lot tensile tests (n=12)
E=3.0 GPa from vendor certs
Potting length and load angle measured per specimen; used as inputs to the model
blend radius was measured on production parts (2.1±0.05 mm) and set to 2.1 mm
Eight stems (sizes 1–5, two repeats for size 3) tested
on an MTS 858, ISO 7206-4 setup
Test fixture replicated ISO 7206-4: 80 mm embedding length in PMMA potting
load vector 10° anterior, 10° lateral; target bending moment 230 N·m
Temperature assumed 23±2°C
Potting length and load angle measured per specimen; used as inputs to the model
blend radius was measured on production parts (2.1±0.05 mm) and set to 2.1 mm in the model
stiffness error 3.5% (mean across n=8 specimens)
stress error 6.9% at the primary gauge
hotspot ordering matched test strain maps in all eight cases
Normalized RMSE across all gauges: 6.2%
